surfaces.coverage: Convex light-curve reconstruction with approximate thermal size: 139.65 km (catalog ±2.09 km; additional shape and thermal-model uncertainty). Thermal size is used as a volume-scale approximation. An alternative pole remains possible. The grid marks unavailable imagery. The physical size is approximately calibrated by assigning the AKARI thermal effective diameter to the mesh volume-equivalent diameter. Neither source mesh nor spin is modified. Convex inversion supplies only broad outline; no resolved craters, concavities, reflectance or regolith texture can be inferred. Select nominal 2016 convex model 1185 (359,25), with 1186 (177,22) retained as an unresolved mirror pole. Hanuš et al. (2016), table of new models, gives 33 dense light curves across five apparitions and sparse data. No calibrated size is in the selected release; AKARI remains an explicit separate thermal-volume approximation.

surfaceSampling.previewPolicy: Radial rays with more than one distinct source intersection are withheld; the triangle atlas samples the source surface in 3D.

transfer.method: Closest full-source triangle point in 3D; source barycentric radius and normal. No radial branch selection.
